task_evaluations.name: AWS S3 Authentication
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I configure authentication for accessing S3 from my data pipeline using different methods (IAM, SSO, keys)?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain AWS credential chains, IAM roles, SSO configuration, and secure best practices.

task_evaluations.name: fsspec Cloud Access
task_evaluations.description: Tests fsspec for cloud storage access
task_evaluations.prompt: Use fsspec to read and write data files from S3, GCS, and Azure with proper configuration.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide fsspec patterns for multiple cloud providers, including configuration and optimization.

task_evaluations.name: Polars Cloud I/O
task_evaluations.description: Tests Polars integration with cloud storage
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I efficiently read Parquet files from S3 into Polars and write results back?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain Polars cloud I/O patterns, credential passing, and optimization options.

task_evaluations.name: DuckDB HTTPFS
task_evaluations.description: Tests DuckDB HTTPFS extension for cloud access
task_evaluations.prompt: Configure DuckDB to query data directly from S3 and GCS using the HTTPFS extension.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide DuckDB HTTPFS setup, credential configuration, and query patterns.

task_evaluations.name: Cross-Cloud Authentication
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I manage authentication when my pipeline needs to access both AWS S3 and GCS in the same workflow?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain handling multiple cloud credentials, isolation patterns, and security considerations.
